storage_rule: Only this empty template is public. Store populated records, identities, contact details, private correspondence and agreements in a separately authorized restricted location, never in public GitHub.

field_dictionary.reference_fields: Pointers to actual restricted records, not invented names, credentials, signatures or approvals. Null means not established, not exempt.
field_dictionary.permitted_artifact_manifest_reference: Exact revisions and hashes for the approved sharing scope, with rights/disclosure basis and validity period.
field_dictionary.result_reference: Permitted observations or actual response, including negative or inconclusive findings; leave null until an activity occurs.
field_dictionary.last_reviewed_at: Actual timezone-aware timestamp of the recorded human review; leave null in this template.

limitations: This is a documentation template and field dictionary, not a deployed contact service or formal JSON Schema validator.
